text: Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: Option B 18.0 to 18.8 s. From directly above, brown floodwater sweeps rightward along the street between four houses until the whole roadway is brown by 18.8 s. The white roof-pod car creeps right a little and stops in the water. The caption sits over the lower two houses.
